{{Quote|Coruscant Security + Customs Enforcement Division {{=}} welcomes you, gentlebeing!|A CSF Customs Droid|<ref name="SWTORcorus" />}}
The '''Customs Enforcement Division''' was a branch of the [[Coruscant Security Force/Legends|Coruscant Security Force]] charged with [[Law enforcement agency/Legends|customs enforcement]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] era. CSF [[Police officer/Legends|police officers]] were assigned as [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] guards and as [[Customs official/Legends|customs]] enforcement [[Agent/Legends|agents]], in which case they were assisted by [[Customs droid/Legends|customs droids]].

A hostage situation at [[Diplomatic Spaceport 27-B]] ensued when a [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] named [[Teff'ith]] took a CSF Customs [[Unidentified Coruscant Security customs guard 1|guard]] hostage and demanded to speak with [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Satele Shan]]. The guard's [[Unidentified Coruscant Security customs guard 2|partner]] called for backup, and over twenty CSF [[Officer/Legends|officers]] responded to the scene. The hostage situation was resolved when Grand Master Shan arrived and Teff'ith surrendered.

==Description==
{{Quote|Do you have any identification, miss?|A CSF customs guard|<ref name="Annihilation">''[[The Old Republic: Annihilation]]''</ref>}}
The Customs Enforcement Division was a section of the [[Coruscant Security Force/Legends|Coruscant Security Force]] charged with [[Law enforcement agency/Legends|customs enforcement]] duties on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. The division stationed [[Police officer/Legends|police officers]] as [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] guards and as [[Customs official/Legends|customs]] [[Agent/Legends|agents]] at checkpoints. [[Customs droid/Legends|Customs droids]] were also utilized at checkpoints to assist the division in identifying new arrivals, verifying their identification, and inspecting their [[Starship/Legends|ship]] manifests.<ref name="SWTORcorus" />

==History==
{{Quote|Just try to remain calm miss, we'll get this sorted out.|A CSF customs guard|<ref name="Annihilation" />}}
{{GameLS}}
[[File:Csfcustomsdroid.png|thumb|left|250px|A Coruscant Security customs droid]]
Around [[3643 BBY]],<ref name="SWTORdate">{{TOR_dates|1}}</ref> during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], the Customs Enforcement Division stopped the [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] known as [[Voidhound]] at the [[Coruscant Spaceport]]. The on-duty Customs [[Droid/Legends|Droid]] noticed an error in the smuggler's identification protocols and cargo logs. When the droid was about to request assistance from a customs enforcement agent, the smuggler uploaded false data that convinced the droid that the smuggler was really named [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Numinn]]. With this information, the customs droid approved the smuggler's entry into Coruscant.<ref name="SWTORcorus" />
{{Endgame}}

In [[3640 BBY]], [[Republic Strategic Information Service]] Agent [[Theron Shan]] sent the smuggler [[Teff'ith]] to Coruscant to give vital information about his [[Operation End Game|mission]] there to [[Supreme Commander (Alliance)/Legends|Supreme Commander]] [[Jace Malcom]] and [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Satele Shan]]. As she entered Coruscant's [[Atmosphere/Legends|airspace]], Teff'ith was contacted by [[Coruscant Flight Control 473]], which directed her to land at [[Diplomatic Spaceport 27-B]]. Upon her arrival at the spaceport, Teff'ith was checked and searched by CSF guards. To them, the shoulder wound that Teff'ith had sustained before leaving for Coruscant and her not being a Jedi did not match with the fact that she had been flying a Jedi craft. Teff'ith continued to insist that she wanted to speak with Grand Master Shan, but the guards simply took her into the spaceport office.<ref name="Annihilation" />

In frustration, Teff'ith grabbed the [[Blaster pistol/Legends|blaster pistol]] sidearm of [[Unidentified Coruscant Security customs guard 1|one]] of the guards. His [[Unidentified Coruscant Security customs guard 2|partner]] ordered her to drop the weapon and release her hostage, but she refused. Instead, she demanded he exit the spaceport office. At first hesitant, the guard complied when his hostage-held partner insisted he do so. Teff'ith then barricaded herself inside the office with the remaining guard. She insisted he contact Shan, which he set about attempting to do. Meanwhile, his partner had called for backup, and within five [[Standard minute/Legends|minutes]] over twenty CSF officers had responded to the scene, constructing a cordon around the office. The guard inside was able to contact Shan, who agreed to come to the spaceport. When the Grand Master arrived, Teff'ith surrendered and informed her of the vital information.<ref name="Annihilation" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Customs Enforcement Division appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Star Wars video games|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] (MMORPG) by [[BioWare]] released on [[December 20]], [[2011]], as part of the missions to Coruscant.<ref name="SWTORcorus" />
